source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    To check setting dedicated port as static for ipv4 is normal.
1. Plug network cable on dedicated  and chcek the link status
2. Power on system and boot into BIOS setup
3. Goto "server mgmt" page to check BMC ip
4. Check the ip source is on Static mode
5. Use this to login BMC Web

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Check the ip can be present on BIOS
2. Check the Web can be login

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- Set dedicated port as static(IPv4) (Dedicated as static IPv4): agent verifies the assigned static address with ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" -H "$BMC_IP" lan print 1 2>&1 | grep -iE "IP Address|Subnet|Gateway" (or Redfish EthernetInterface read via curl -s -k -u "$BMC_USER:$BMC_PASS" "https://$BMC_IP/redfish/v1/Managers/1/EthernetInterfaces/1" 2>&1); entering the static IP + web-login are operator/BMC-UI steps.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return the lan-print/Redfish IPv4 static address so the user confirms the Dedicated port is static(IPv4) and reachable; the static-entry + web-login are operator/UI.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: changing to a bad static IP can cut management access; enter a valid address and keep a console path.

original_test_intent: Verify that the dedicated BMC port accepts the owner-approved static IPv4 configuration, presents it in BIOS Server Management and supports authenticated BMC WebUI access at that address.
original_method: An engineer connects the dedicated port, enters BIOS, confirms Static mode and its IPv4 address, then logs in to the BMC WebUI at the configured address and checks for errors.
manual_activity: The physical cable action, BIOS Static-mode/address inspection and BMC WebUI login are source-mandated core acceptance steps requiring an engineer; automated LAN readback is corroborating evidence only.
required_inputs: Conflict-free static IPv4 address, prefix/subnet, gateway, VLAN and routing policy
Current BMC network values and exact restoration method
Credentials, console/KVM access, maintenance and network-owner approval
safety_requirements: Do not enter an unreserved address or modify an unmapped management channel.
Verify address non-use and preserve an independent console path before the change.
Protect credentials and avoid plaintext command arguments or unapproved TLS bypass.
Stop on duplicate IP, wrong route, login failure or management loss; do not automatically retry with alternate values.
agent_execution_scope: Capture pre/post mapped-channel source, IPv4/prefix/gateway/MAC and BMC health through an approved read-only interface.
Correlate network-owner reservation and operator BIOS/WebUI evidence.
Verify final reachability and unexpected logs while leaving the verdict to the engineer.
engineer_actions: Approve the reserved address and rollback plan.
Perform the cable, BIOS Static-mode/address and WebUI-login steps.
Compare exact values and issue PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Useful only after configuration. It must not assume LAN channel 1 or a fixed Redfish instance, and its credential/TLS flags are unsafe formal defaults.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Discover the vendor-supported mapped endpoint, protect credentials and capture complete read-only source/address/prefix/gateway output after the engineer's UI action.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Static IPv4, BIOS display, WebUI login, physical cable and 5/0-minute fields are preserved without inventing address values.

modernized_recommendation.status: RETAIN HUMAN BIOS/WEBUI METHOD WITH CONFLICT-SAFE READBACK
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record the current configuration, validate the reserved address with the network owner, verify console recovery, have the engineer enter/confirm the static values, then correlate BIOS, API readback, routing and authenticated WebUI evidence.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Mapped BMC port on the approved IPv4 management network.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC firmware, management API/tool and network-plan revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform BMC network guide and approved project IP allocation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds conflict validation, rollback and stable mapping without replacing UI acceptance.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; readback alone does not prove the specified BIOS/WebUI experience.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Reserved IPv4 tuple, mapping and rollback.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: One incorrect octet, prefix or gateway can isolate the BMC or collide with another host.

project_override_considerations: The project supplies the actual static IPv4 tuple and decides whether it remains configured. Missing values are execution readiness, not permanent BLOCKED. An API-only plan is a coverage change because BIOS presentation and WebUI login are explicit criteria.
expected_evidence: Network-approved address reservation, mapped channel/MAC, current state and rollback
BIOS screenshots showing Static source and exact IPv4 values
Authenticated BMC WebUI login at the configured address
Post-change readback/reachability, conflict/error review and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently requires static IPv4 configuration, BIOS visibility and BMC WebUI access on the dedicated port.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The method is clear. Project-specific addresses and authorizations are readiness prerequisites, not a permanent block.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retain readback and recovery warning, but not its PARTIAL classification under the locked manual UI rule.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retain its complete IPv4 and conflict-control analysis while reclassifying the core as MANUAL ONLY.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Distinguishes network-parameter readiness, supporting automation and the human UI verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents an unreserved or wrong-channel address change and requires exact value comparison rather than generic reachability.
independent_technical_reasoning: Although configuration readback is automatable, the source makes BIOS display and BMC WebUI login the acceptance criteria. These are human UI activities under V3.1, so the case is MANUAL ONLY with agent support rather than PARTIAL.
